meta.title: Convert
meta.description: Converts images, data, encodings, colors and units in the browser. Nothing is uploaded.
meta.imageAlt: Convert, a Dynamogic tool: images, data, encodings, colors and units in the browser.
tagline: Images, data, encodings, colors and units. Processing stays on this device.
footer.privacy: No uploads, no cookies, no analytics.
footer.credit: Un outil Dynamogic / A Dynamogic tool
nav.label: Converters
action.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
images.lead: PNG, JPEG, WebP and AVIF, either way. Several files download as one ZIP archive.
images.dropHint: or choose files. 50 MB maximum per file.
images.qualityPng: PNG is lossless: the quality slider does not apply.
images.resizeHint: Leave blank to keep the original size. With proportions on, both values set the maximum box.
images.jpegHint: JPEG has no transparency: transparent areas become white.
images.avifUnsupported: This browser cannot encode AVIF. A conversion to AVIF will be refused. WebP, PNG and JPEG work. AVIF encoding is available in recent Chrome and Edge.
images.copiedPng: Image copied. The clipboard receives a PNG.
data.lead: JSON, CSV, YAML and XML. When something fails, the message names the line.
data.placeholder: Paste JSON, CSV, YAML or XML.
data.drop: You can also drop a text file, up to 50 MB.
data.csvHint: The first CSV row is the header. The separator (comma, semicolon or tab) is detected from that row.
data.xmlHint: A JSON array is wrapped in <root><item>. Attributes use an @ prefix.
encoding.lead: Base64 for text and files, URL encoding, and HTML entities.
encoding.placeholder: Paste the text to encode or decode.
encoding.fileDrop: Drop a file to encode as Base64. 50 MB maximum.
encoding.fileNameHint: Used when you decode Base64 into a file.
encoding.urlHint: Spaces become %20. A plus sign is not read as a space.
encoding.htmlHint: Encoding escapes & < > " '. Decoding accepts common named entities and é or é.
colors.lead: HEX, RGB, HSL and OKLCH stay in step. Contrast is checked against black and white, using WCAG 2.
colors.outOfGamut: This OKLCH color is outside the sRGB gamut. The preview and the other formats show the nearest color.
units.lead: Length, weight, temperature, file size (1000 and 1024 bases), time and speed.
units.dataNote: kB, MB, GB and TB count by 1000. KiB, MiB, GiB and TiB count by 1024.
app.crash: Something unexpected interrupted the page. Reload it. Your files do not leave this device.
error.empty_input: Nothing to convert. Paste some content or drop a file.
error.file_too_large: This file is over 50 MB. Choose a smaller one: Convert stops at 50 MB so the browser stays responsive.
error.not_text: This file does not look like text. For an image, open the Images tab. For Base64, open the Encoding tab.
error.invalid_number: This is not a number. Use digits, a sign, a comma or a dot. Examples: 12.5 or 1.2e3.
error.number_too_large: This number is too large for an exact conversion. Enter a smaller value.
error.number_negative: This quantity cannot be negative. Enter zero or a positive number.
error.below_absolute_zero: This temperature is below absolute zero (−273.15 °C, −459.67 °F, 0 K). Enter a temperature at or above that.
error.unknown_unit: Unknown unit. Choose a unit from the list.
error.unit_mismatch: These units do not measure the same quantity. Stay within the same list.
error.json_invalid: Invalid JSON at line {line}, column {column}. Look for a missing comma, quote or brace.
error.csv_unclosed_quote: Unclosed quote at line {line}. Close the field with a quote. To write a quote inside a field, double it ("").
error.csv_invalid: Unreadable CSV at line {line}. Check the separator (comma or semicolon) and that each row has no more columns than the header.
error.yaml_invalid: Invalid YAML at line {line}, column {column}. Check the indentation (spaces, not tabs) and the colon after each key.
error.xml_invalid: Invalid XML at line {line}, column {column}. Check that there is a single root, that every tag is closed, and that & < > are written as & < >.
error.xml_doctype: DOCTYPE declarations are refused, so external entities cannot be loaded. Remove the DOCTYPE. The entities < > & " ' still work.
error.base64_invalid: This is not valid Base64. Use only A–Z, a–z, 0–9, +, / and = padding. URL-safe - and _ are accepted.
error.base64_not_utf8: This Base64 is not UTF-8 text. Switch to file mode to download the raw bytes.
error.url_invalid: Invalid % sequence. Each % must be followed by two hex digits, for example %20 for a space.
error.html_bad_ampersand: Incomplete ampersand at line {line}, column {column}. Write & for an &, or a full entity such as < or é.
error.html_unknown_entity: Unknown HTML entity “{detail}” at line {line}, column {column}. Use a known entity (& < é) or a numeric form (é or é).
error.html_bad_codepoint: Invalid character code at line {line}, column {column}. Use a Unicode code point, for example é or 😀.
error.hex_invalid: Invalid HEX. Write #RGB or #RRGGBB, for example #c4512c.
error.rgb_invalid: Invalid RGB. Write rgb(196, 81, 44) or 196 81 44, with components from 0 to 255.
error.rgb_range: An RGB component is outside 0–255. Bring each value back into that range.
error.hsl_invalid: Invalid HSL. Write hsl(14, 63%, 47%): hue 0–360, saturation and lightness 0–100%.
error.hsl_range: Saturation or lightness is outside 0–100%. Hue may go past 360: it wraps around the circle.
error.oklch_invalid: Invalid OKLCH. Write oklch(0.62 0.13 42) or oklch(62% 0.13 42). L is 0 to 1 (or 0–100%), C is positive, H is an angle.
error.oklch_range: OKLCH lightness must be between 0 and 1 (or 0% and 100%), and chroma cannot be negative.
error.color_alpha_unsupported: Transparency is not supported. Remove the alpha component, for example #c4512c rather than #c4512cff.
error.image_type_unsupported: Unsupported format. Use a PNG, JPEG, WebP or AVIF file.
error.image_too_many_pixels: This image is over 16,384 pixels on a side or 40 megapixels. Shrink it before converting.
error.image_decode_failed: Could not read this image. The file may be damaged, or this browser may not decode AVIF. Try PNG, JPEG or WebP, or a recent browser.
error.image_encode_failed: Encoding failed. Try another format, or lower the size and quality.
error.avif_encode_unsupported: This browser cannot encode AVIF. Choose WebP, PNG or JPEG, or open Convert in recent Chrome or Edge.
error.dimension_invalid: Width and height must be whole numbers of at least 1 pixel, or stay empty to keep the original size.
error.dimension_too_large: The requested size is over 16,384 pixels on a side or 40 megapixels. Reduce the width or height.
error.quality_invalid: Quality must be a number from 1 to 100.
error.zip_failed: The ZIP archive could not be created. Download the files one by one.
error.worker_failed: The conversion thread stopped. Reload the page and try a smaller file.
error.generic: The conversion failed. Check the content and try again.
